verdict.rationale: Swell documents a visual Theme Editor that storefront apps like Proxima support, so merchants can customize the look and feel of their store, and Proxima can upgrade, duplicate and distribute themes. The evidence does not show a catalog of professionally designed themes, and it does not explicitly cover section, layout or branding controls; Shopify OS 2.0 compatibility only implies section support. Missing for 10: evidence of a professionally designed theme library, explicit no-code section/layout and branding customization, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can launch a polished storefront from professionally designed themes and customize layout, sections, and branding without code

citations.quote: Themes are optionally implemented by storefront apps to make it easier for merchants to customize the look and feel of their store.
Proxima is Swell's first official storefront app intended to help merchants get started quickly by supporting compatibility with the well-known structure of Shopify Online Store 2.0 themes.

A storefront app, such as Proxima, may implement themes and thereby support the Swell Theme Editor as well as a number of storefront features such as the ability to upgrade, duplicate, and distribute themes.
supported by our visual theme editor
